name: Food Bank Delicious Sharing Concert
original_name: 세계 식량의 날 기념 푸드뱅크, 맛있는 나눔 콘서트
overview: The “Delicious Sharing Concert,” where attendees can enter by donating two cans of food at no additional cost, is a charity concert designed to raise awareness about food sharing—specifically, how families can help neighbors in need by donating surplus food from their homes.
